notes.title: ☪️ TSUNDERE MILFIN — Update 1.15 is live!

A fresh update has just been released for our beloved office sim — check it out now!

 New situation on the map is available! 4 levels, 1 minigame and 1 fully animated art. That's not all! The development of the game continues. This is just a small update. New situations are already in development.
